Reverse Assistant 0.1.3 Alpha

Adds application update checks with verified signatures and explicit installation confirmation, readable C++ naming proposals, and hidden Windows analysis helpers. Includes the automatic Java setup fix.

Windows x64 Alpha build. Installation, analysis and renaming have been tested by the maintainer in a Windows VM. A full upgrade from an older updater-enabled build remains to be tested.

Updates are not installed silently. Windows may warn because the installer has no Authenticode certificate. Back up important projects before testing an Alpha upgrade.
